decision: D53: Ads API v1 default; v0 only as named exceptions

EX-BILLING.why: Invoices, billing profiles and payment methods have no v1 operation.

EX-BRAND-ANALYTICS.why: Brand Metrics, benchmarks, Stores insights and MMM are separate v0 report APIs outside v1 reporting.

EX-BRAND-ASSETS.why: Creative asset library, SB media upload and store / page lookups used by SB / SD creatives are v0 only (v1 BrandStores* are query-only).

EX-BRAND-SAFETY.watch: v1 SD Targets contract (negative brand targets)
EX-BRAND-SAFETY.why: Sponsored Display brand-safety deny list and its status/results polling have no v1 operation.

EX-BUDGET-RULES.why: Budget rules (SP/SB/SD) exist only in v0; the migration skills mark them "keep using v3/v4".

EX-BUDGET-USAGE-RECS.watch: release-notes/ads-api-v1.md; the Stream v1 budget-usage dataset has no v2 successor
EX-BUDGET-USAGE-RECS.why: Budget usage and budget recommendations have no v1 operation (migration skills: not migrable).

EX-CHANGE-HISTORY.why: POST /history exists only in v0 and covers SP and SB campaigns only (no SD, no actor).

EX-ELIGIBILITY.why: Program and product eligibility checks have no GA v1 operation (v1 AdvertiserProductGroupEligibilities is beta and about product groups).

EX-EVENTS.why: SP /sp/v1/events is v0; v1 CreateEvent is closed beta.

EX-EXPORTS.why: Bulk async metadata export (campaigns, ad groups, ads, targets) exists only in v0; Amazon states the Exports API is NOT affected by the v3 reporting deprecation.

EX-MANAGER-LINKING.why: Linking / unlinking advertising accounts to a manager account is v0 only (v1 ManagerAccounts: create / query / update).

EX-MODERATION.why: Ad moderation results (and pre-moderation) are v0 only.

EX-OPTIMIZATION-RULES.why: Rule-based bidding / optimization rules have no v1 operation. Placement and audience bid adjustments themselves ARE in v1 (campaign optimizations.bidSettings).

EX-PORTFOLIOS.watch: v1 release notes; reference/amazon-ads/overview "Future vision" (rules, recommendations)
EX-PORTFOLIOS.why: v1 has no portfolio entity (v1 campaigns only carry portfolioId and a portfolioIdFilter).

EX-PROFILES.watch: reference/amazon-ads/getting-started.md (still points to the Profiles API)
EX-PROFILES.why: Profiles remain the source of the Amazon-Advertising-API-Scope value and of marketplace / currency / timezone / account type; v1 AdvertiserAccount carries alternateIds and may replace it - verify with a real account before dropping.

EX-TARGETING-DISCOVERY.why: Category browse, refinements, product counts, brand search, locations and audience lists used to build targets have no v1 operation.

EX-TARGETING-RECS.why: Bid / keyword / product / category / theme recommendations, target promotion groups, SB headline recs, forecasts, insights and campaign diagnostics are v0 only. v1 Recommendations covers only 4 types today.

EX-TERMS-TOKEN.why: Terms token creation / lookup used by account registration has no v1 operation.

EX-TEST-ACCOUNTS.why: Test account creation is v0 only; needs scope advertising::test:create_account.

EX-USERS-PERMISSIONS.why: User invitations, permissions and roles are v0 only (v1 has only beta account-link invites).
